results of the 13th Consent Requests and STID Proposal

On 24 August 2026, Thames Water Utilities Limited ("TWUL") announced the launch of its 13th Consent Requests and STID Proposal. Details of the 13th Consent Requests and the STID Proposal can be found in the announcement (the "Launch Announcement") here:
Terms used but not otherwise defined have the meanings given to them in the Launch Announcement, 13th Consent Requests and STID Proposal, as applicable.
Approval of the 13th Consent Requests and STID Proposal
TWUL announces today that the 13th Consent Requests and the STID Proposal have been approved.
Given the approvals above, TWUL and the Super Senior Issuer will proceed with the implementation of the consents and amendments outlined in the 13th Consent Requests and the STID Proposal.
